question: Among female superheroes published by Dark Horse Comics, find the one with the highest strength attribute and return her full name along with the count of her superpowers.

prediction.sql:
WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT s.XCL_018 AS hero_id, s.XCL_020 AS full_name, ha.XCL_011 AS strength_score
    FROM superhero s
    INNER JOIN gender g ON s.XCL_021 = g.XCL_007
    INNER JOIN publisher p ON s.XCL_026 = p.XCL_014
    INNER JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.XCL_018 = ha.XCL_009
    INNER JOIN attribute a ON ha.XCL_010 = a.XCL_003
    WHERE g.XCL_008 = 'Female'
      AND p.XCL_015 = 'Dark Horse Comics'
      AND a.XCL_004 = 'Strength'
),
top_hero AS (
    SELECT hero_id, full_name
    FROM eligible
    ORDER BY strength_score DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT th.full_name, COUNT(hp.XCL_013) AS power_count
FROM top_hero th
LEFT JOIN hero_power hp ON th.hero_id = hp.XCL_012
GROUP BY th.hero_id, th.full_name

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT s.XCL_018 AS hero_id, s.XCL_020 AS full_name, ha.XCL_011 AS strength_score
    FROM superhero s
    INNER JOIN gender g ON s.XCL_021 = g.XCL_007
    INNER JOIN publisher p ON s.XCL_026 = p.XCL_014
    INNER JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.XCL_018 = ha.XCL_009
    INNER JOIN attribute a ON ha.XCL_010 = a.XCL_003
    WHERE g.XCL_008 = 'Female'
      AND p.XCL_015 = 'Dark Horse Comics'
      AND a.XCL_004 = 'Strength'
),
top_hero AS (
    SELECT hero_id, full_name
    FROM eligible
    ORDER BY strength_score DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT th.full_name, COUNT(hp.XCL_013) AS power_count
FROM top_hero th
LEFT JOIN hero_power hp ON th.hero_id = hp.XCL_012
GROUP BY th.hero_id, th.full_name

    SELECT s.XCL_018 AS hero_id, s.XCL_020 AS full_name, ha.XCL_011 AS strength_score
    FROM superhero s
    INNER JOIN gender g ON s.XCL_021 = g.XCL_007
    INNER JOIN publisher p ON s.XCL_026 = p.XCL_014
    INNER JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.XCL_018 = ha.XCL_009
    INNER JOIN attribute a ON ha.XCL_010 = a.XCL_003
    WHERE g.XCL_008 = 'Female'
      AND p.XCL_015 = 'Dark Horse Comics'
      AND a.XCL_004 = 'Strength'
),
top_hero AS (
    SELECT hero_id, full_name
    FROM eligible
    ORDER BY strength_score DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT th.full_name, COUNT(hp.XCL_013) AS power_count
FROM top_hero th
LEFT JOIN hero_power hp ON th.hero_id = hp.XCL_012
GROUP BY th.hero_id, th.full_name

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_019", COUNT(T6."XCL_013") AS power_count
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN gender AS T2 ON T1."XCL_021" = T2."XCL_007"
INNER JOIN publisher AS T3 ON T1."XCL_026" = T3."XCL_014"
INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T4 ON T1."XCL_018" = T4."XCL_009"
INNER JOIN attribute AS T5 ON T4."XCL_010" = T5."XCL_003"
INNER JOIN hero_power AS T6 ON T1."XCL_018" = T6."XCL_012"
WHERE T2."XCL_008" = 'Female'
  AND T3."XCL_015" = 'Dark Horse Comics'
  AND T5."XCL_004" = 'Strength'
ORDER BY T4."XCL_011" DESC
LIMIT 1

FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.XCL_021 = g.XCL_007
JOIN publisher p ON s.XCL_026 = p.XCL_014
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.XCL_018 = ha.XCL_009
JOIN attribute a ON ha.XCL_010 = a.XCL_003
LEFT JOIN hero_power hp ON s.XCL_018 = hp.XCL_012

    AND p.XCL_015 = 'Dark Horse Comics'
